title: Position: Modular Memory is the Key to Continual Learning Agents
summary: Position paper arguing for modular memory that combines rapid in-context updates with stable in-weight adaptation.
open_question: Which modular memory designs improve held-out transfer at a fixed compute and memory budget?

title: MemoryBench: A Benchmark for Memory and Continual Learning in LLM Systems
summary: Benchmark of feedback-driven memory and continual-learning behavior across tasks and domains.
open_question: Can benchmark gains distinguish behavioral learning from retrieving prior facts?

title: Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning: Continual Learning in LLM Agents Without Gradient Updates
summary: Uses retrieved trajectories and action-advantage estimates to adapt an agent without gradient updates.
open_question: What happens when the experience bank contains contradictory or forged trajectories?

title: Outcome Rewards Do Not Guarantee Verifiable or Causally Important Reasoning
summary: Shows why greater answer accuracy from verifiable-reward training need not entail faithful or independently sufficient reasoning traces.
open_question: Can training signals improve verified intermediate steps while preserving final-task accuracy?

title: Continual Learning Bench: Evaluating Frontier AI Systems in Real-World Stateful Environments
summary: Proposes expert-validated, stateful task streams to isolate improvement due to prior experience.
open_question: How robust are apparent gains when latent task families and memory budgets are controlled?

title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
summary: Proposes a memory-centered taxonomy and evaluates action-level retention, adaptation, and transfer.
open_question: Does adaptive memory management learn reusable procedures rather than storing larger traces?

title: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads
summary: Studies construction, retrieval, and generation costs of different agent memory designs.
open_question: Which read/write scheduling decisions yield the best transfer per unit memory and compute?

title: OSWorld 2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
summary: Benchmark designed around extended computer-use workflows and stepwise checkpoints.
open_question: How does error recovery interact with memory and verification in long workflows?

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
summary: Interleaves model-produced reasoning with environment actions and observations.
open_question: How can an agent independently verify actions instead of trusting its own reasoning trace?

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reuses language feedback from previous trials as a memory-based improvement mechanism.
open_question: When does reflective memory overfit and worsen subsequent decisions?

title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
summary: Introduces stored experiences, reflection, and retrieval for interactive simulated agents.
open_question: How do reflections degrade under contradictory or adversarial experiences?

title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
summary: Introduces DreamerV3, a model-based RL method that learns by imagining future trajectories.
open_question: How well does control improve under shifted dynamics and model uncertainty?

title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
summary: Studies self-supervised video prediction representations and action-conditioned robot planning.
open_question: Do latent visual predictions support correct intervention-based reasoning on unseen physics?

title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
summary: Trains vision-language-action models that map multimodal observations to robot actions.
open_question: What transfers to unfamiliar objects and actions without unsafe real-world exploration?

title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
summary: Assesses language agents in multiple interactive environments.
open_question: Which benchmark failures persist once tool execution and feedback are verified?

title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
summary: Measures changes to real repositories against software issue requirements.
open_question: How can long-horizon verification distinguish a passing patch from a generalizable repair policy?

title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
summary: Studies a selective state-space model architecture as an alternative to attention-heavy sequence modeling.
open_question: What workloads genuinely favor selective state-space models at equal quality and memory budgets?

title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization: Eliciting Strong Capabilities With Weak Supervision
summary: Investigates whether stronger models can learn from labels supplied by weaker supervisors.
open_question: How can weak oversight detect sophisticated failures in stronger autonomous systems?

title: Towards Causal Representation Learning
summary: Connects causal variable discovery from observations with transfer, robustness, and generalization challenges.
open_question: How can causal variables be identified without unrealistic supervision or interventions?

title: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery
summary: Studies automated generation, coding, experimentation, and review of AI research ideas.
open_question: Can automated research produce independently replicated scientific discoveries instead of evaluator-approved writeups?

title: Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate
summary: Investigates whether dialogue among multiple model instances improves factuality and reasoning.
open_question: Does debate retain benefits when agents share correlated errors or collude?

title: Federated Learning: Strategies for Improving Communication Efficiency
summary: Examines structured and compressed client updates to reduce communication in distributed training.
open_question: Can continual federated learning reduce communication while controlling forgetting and privacy leakage?

title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
summary: Investigates model-size and training-token allocation under a fixed compute budget.
open_question: Do compute-optimal scaling rules remain stable for multimodal continual learners?

title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: Introduces the transformer, the architecture behind modern language and speech models.
open_question: Which attention alternatives keep quality while cutting cost for long audio sequences?

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning by learning low-rank weight updates.
open_question: How much low-resource-language data does LoRA need to close the gap with full fine-tuning?

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Shows that prompting for intermediate steps improves multi-step reasoning in large models.
open_question: Does chain-of-thought help equally when prompts and answers are in Urdu?

title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
summary: Instruction tuning with reinforcement learning from human feedback (InstructGPT).
open_question: How well does preference data collected in English transfer to low-resource languages?

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
summary: Optimizes preferences directly without training a separate reward model.
open_question: Can small native-speaker preference sets fix tone and politeness errors in Urdu assistants?

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
summary: Combines a retriever with a generator so answers are grounded in retrieved documents.
open_question: How much does cross-lingual retrieval (Urdu query, English documents) reduce answer quality?

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
summary: Trains a model to decide when to retrieve and to critique its own outputs.
open_question: Are self-critique signals reliable enough to trigger safe escalation in voice agents?

title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
summary: Finds models use information at the start and end of long contexts better than the middle.
open_question: Does position bias get worse for low-resource-language context?

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
summary: Tiered memory management that pages information in and out of a limited context window.
open_question: Which memory tier policies keep stale facts out of long-running support conversations?

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
summary: Studies agreement between strong LLM judges and humans and documents position, verbosity and self-enhancement biases.
open_question: Does judge-human agreement hold for Urdu and Sindhi responses?

title: G-Eval: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment
summary: Rubric-guided LLM evaluation with chain-of-thought and probability-weighted scores.
open_question: Do rubrics written in English transfer to judging Urdu outputs?

title: Large Language Models are not Fair Evaluators
summary: Shows LLM judges are sensitive to answer order and proposes calibration methods.
open_question: Is position bias larger when the judged answers are in a low-resource language?

title: τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
summary: Simulated-user benchmark for tool-using agents with domain policies; introduces pass^k to measure consistency across trials.
open_question: What does a τ-bench-style benchmark look like for spoken Urdu customer-support tasks?

title: wav2vec 2.0: A Framework for Self-Supervised Learning of Speech Representations
summary: Self-supervised speech pretraining that enables ASR with very little labeled data.
open_question: How few labeled minutes of Sindhi speech give usable ASR after self-supervised pretraining?

title: XLS-R: Self-supervised Cross-lingual Speech Representation Learning at Scale
summary: Large cross-lingual wav2vec 2.0 models pretrained on speech from many languages.
open_question: Which related languages transfer best to Sindhi ASR?

title: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
summary: Whisper: multilingual ASR and translation trained on large weakly supervised web audio.
open_question: How does Whisper perform on Urdu-English code-switched and Roman Urdu speech?

title: Scaling Speech Technology to 1,000+ Languages
summary: Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS): ASR, TTS and language ID for over 1,000 languages.
open_question: Is MMS or Whisper the stronger baseline for Sindhi?

title: FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech
summary: N-way parallel speech benchmark in 102 languages built on FLoRes-101, with about 12 hours per language.
open_question: How representative is read FLEURS speech of real conversational Urdu?

title: Common Voice: A Massively-Multilingual Speech Corpus
summary: Crowdsourced, openly licensed multilingual speech corpus with community validation.
open_question: How much do speaker and accent imbalances in crowdsourced Urdu data bias evaluation?

title: SeamlessM4T: Massively Multilingual & Multimodal Machine Translation
summary: Unified model for speech and text translation across many languages.
open_question: Can speech-to-speech translation serve as a fallback for languages with weak dialogue models?

title: Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue
summary: Full-duplex speech-to-speech dialogue model with about 200 ms practical latency and an inner-monologue text stream.
open_question: What would it take to adapt full-duplex dialogue models to Urdu?

title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
summary: Reports power-law relationships between loss and model size, data and compute.
open_question: Do scaling laws hold for low-resource languages with limited data?

title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
summary: Trains assistants with AI feedback guided by a written set of principles.
open_question: Can principle-guided feedback be written and checked in Urdu?

title: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems
summary: Introduces GSM8K and shows trained verifiers improve answer selection.
open_question: Do verifiers trained in English catch errors in translated reasoning tasks?

title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
summary: Self-supervised method for teaching a model when and how to call external tools.
open_question: How often do ASR errors corrupt tool arguments in spoken agents?

title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
summary: Lifelong-learning agent that grows a reusable skill library in Minecraft.
open_question: Do skill libraries transfer when the task language changes?

title: SONIC-O1: A Real-World Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models on Audio-Video Understanding
summary: Human-verified audio-video benchmark (~60 h, 231 clips, 13 domains) for summarization, MCQ and temporal localization; reports a large closed-vs-open gap on localization and demographic gaps. NeurIPS 2026 workshop poster.
open_question: Does adding explicit audio events close the open-model gap on temporal localization?

title: TimeLens: Rethinking Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
summary: Strong grounding baseline built mainly by improving data quality and simple design choices; argues MLLMs know 'what' but not 'when'.
open_question: Which label-quality fixes matter most for audio-visual grounding?

title: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
summary: Predicts sets of evidence intervals; SFT then GRPO with IoU plus a temporal Wasserstein reward; 93K-instance dataset. Vision-only evaluation.
open_question: Does the recipe transfer when audio and subtitles are added?

title: GroundVTS: Visual Token Sampling in Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Query-guided filtering of visual tokens before the LLM to keep time-relevant information.
open_question: Can audio cues guide token selection too?

title: SlotVTG: Object-Centric Adapter for Generalizable Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Object-centric slot adapter to improve out-of-domain temporal grounding.
open_question: Do action-centric units generalize better than object-centric ones?

title: E.M.Ground: A Temporal Grounding Vid-LLM with Holistic Event Perception and Matching
summary: Models events as continuous, coherent units rather than isolated frames for grounding.
open_question: How does event-level perception interact with audio boundaries?

title: MLLMs Know When Before Speaking: Revealing and Recovering Temporal Grounding via Attention Cues
summary: Finds a sparse set of attention heads that focus on the correct interval even when generated timestamps are wrong.
open_question: Do the same heads exist in omni (audio-video) models?

title: Time-R1: Post-Training Large Vision Language Model for Temporal Video Grounding
summary: RL post-training with verifiable IoU reward; strong results from ~2.5K training samples; introduces TVGBench.
open_question: Is the data efficiency preserved for long audio-visual videos?

title: TempSamp-R1: Effective Temporal Sampling with Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Video LLMs
summary: Shows on-policy GRPO explores poorly in large temporal spaces; mixes ground-truth guidance into policy updates. NeurIPS 2025.
open_question: Which off-policy signals help most when timestamps come from two modalities?

title: TempR1: Improving Temporal Understanding of MLLMs via Temporal-Aware Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-task RL over five temporal tasks (~60K videos) on Qwen2.5-VL-7B.
open_question: Does adding audio-visual tasks to the mix help or hurt vision-only tasks?

title: ChronusOmni: Improving Time Awareness of Omni Large Language Models
summary: Interleaves timestamp tokens with video and audio tokens, adds RL ordering rewards, and releases ChronusAV for explicit and implicit audio-visual grounding.
open_question: How well does it handle non-English and code-switched speech?

title: Nemotron-Labs-Audio-Visual Flamingo: Open Audio-Visual Intelligence for Long and Complex Videos
summary: Three-stage curriculum from short perception to long multi-event reasoning, with timestamp-grounded chain-of-thought.
open_question: Are the timestamp-grounded reasoning steps faithful to the evidence?

title: LVOmniBench: Pioneering Long Audio-Video Understanding Evaluation for Omnimodal LLMs
summary: Manually curated benchmark for long-form audio-video understanding covering memory, temporal localization and perception.
open_question: Which failures come from memory vs from cross-modal alignment?

title: OmniVideoBench: Towards Audio-Visual Understanding Evaluation for Omni MLLMs
summary: Audio-visual reasoning benchmark with 13 question types, including temporal and causal; ICLR 2026.
open_question: How much accuracy remains when audio is removed?

title: VCRBench: Exploring Long-form Causal Reasoning Capabilities of Large Video Language Models
summary: Causal ordering of shuffled procedural clips; finds models lean on language priors; proposes recognition-reasoning decomposition.
open_question: Does an explicit action-event log reduce reliance on language priors?

title: CausalStep: A Benchmark for Explicit Stepwise Causal Reasoning in Videos
summary: Stepwise causal QA over causally linked video segments with diagnostic metrics.
open_question: Can stepwise causal QA be extended to audio-driven causes?

title: Scaling the Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via Visual Memory Mechanism
summary: FlexMem: training-free memory over visual KV caches with recall strategies; runs on a single consumer GPU. CVPR 2026.
open_question: Can audio KV caches be stored and recalled the same way?

title: From Verbatim to Gist: Distilling Pyramidal Multimodal Memory via Semantic Information Bottleneck for Long-Horizon Video Agents
summary: MM-Mem: pyramid memory from detailed to summarized, for offline and streaming video.
open_question: Which memory level is needed for temporal localization vs QA?

title: Visual Agentic Memory: Enabling Online Long Video Understanding via Online Indexing, Hierarchical Memory, and Agentic Retrieval
summary: Online indexing plus hierarchical memory and agentic retrieval; scales to month-long streams.
open_question: How should audio events be indexed alongside frames?

title: Semantic Event Graphs for Long-Form Video Question Answering
summary: Converts object-tracking proximity into start/end events in a temporal scene graph, cutting tokens sharply; small evaluation (5 videos), no audio or action recognition.
open_question: Do action-recognition and audio events beat object-proximity events?

title: Agentic Very Long Video Understanding
summary: EGAgent: planning agent that searches entity scene graphs plus visual and audio data over days of egocentric video.
open_question: How much does the graph contribute vs the hybrid search tools?

title: GraphThinker: Reinforcing Video Reasoning with Event Graph Thinking
summary: MLLM builds an event-based scene graph as an intermediate reasoning step, trained with RL to reduce hallucination.
open_question: Are the generated graphs temporally accurate, or only plausible?
